name: Half-Life Movement + FPS Camera
author: EthhhSDK
description: Showcase C# mod: Valve HLSDK pmove movement (friction, ground/air acceleration, bunnyhop cap, HL jump and gravity) plus a mouse-look FPS camera. F2 toggles, F3 panics. Movement math ported from half-life-steam_legacy/pm_shared/pm_shared.c.
